messages.subject: International Natural Resources Executive | ESG, Government Relations & External Affairs
messages.body:
Dear Swann Executive Search Team,

I am reaching out for consideration for senior international leadership mandates across natural resources, mining, energy and infrastructure.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio spans government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, external and corporate affairs, strategic partnerships, executive communications and high-stakes stakeholder coordination within a major gold-mining operation.

My strongest fit is in Director, VP, Country and Regional appointments where responsible development, institutional credibility, social licence and operating execution must work together. I engage ministries, regulators, communities, executive leadership and technical functions, translating external requirements into accountable internal action.

Swann's global focus on executive and board search across natural resources, energy and infrastructure makes this a focused introduction. I am internationally mobile and open to expatriate and rotational leadership appointments across the GCC, Africa, Asia-Pacific, Europe and the Americas.

My executive CV is attached for review. I would value consideration for suitable mandates spanning ESG and Sustainability, Government Relations, External and Corporate Affairs, Stakeholder Relations, Strategic Partnerships and Country Leadership.

Best regards,

Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
Georgetown, Guyana
